name: Commonwealth public sector services

regulators.name: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)
Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (Information Commissioner review and complaints)
Administrative Review Tribunal (reviews decisions); decision-making agencies bear the notice duties
Commonwealth Ombudsman (with OAIC and Attorney-General's Department)

scope_notes: Red-team and reference coverage for citizen-facing agents of Commonwealth agencies: privacy (agencies are APP entities), FOI requests, notice of review rights under the ART Act 2024, and Ombudsman guidance on automated decisions. State and Territory governments are not covered.
known_gaps: PGPA Act 2013 (C2013A00123) ss25 to 29 (care and diligence; honesty, good faith and proper purpose; use of position; use of information; disclosure of interests) verified as section headings in Compilation No. 4 (C2017C00269, 2017-08-23, which the Register API reports as latest). Left out: they bind officials (people), not an agent's replies; only s28 (use of information) is indirectly relevant and overlaps APP 6.

Disability Discrimination Act 1992 (Cth) provision of services and goods (likely s24) not opened; it may give an enforceable basis for NO_HUMAN_OR_ACCESSIBLE_ALTERNATIVE, which is currently guidance-only.
Enabling-Act review rights (e.g. Social Security (Administration) Act 1999 internal review and notice provisions) not checked; these may displace ART Act s266 via s266(6)(a) for specific programs.
Australian Government Agencies Privacy Code (registered APP code for agencies) not read.
OAIC FOI Guidelines under FOI Act s93A, and APP Guidelines, not read.
Archives Act 1983 and Commonwealth secrecy provisions (e.g. Criminal Code s122.4A) not considered.
Ombudsman Act 1976 and the right to complain to the Ombudsman not verified from statute; Ombudsman complaint option is cited only from the ADM Guide.
DTA policy detailed requirements, agentic AI addendum and AI technical standard not read; the policy's mandatory status was verified only from the 'Need to know' page.
APP 1.7 to 1.9 commence 10 December 2026 and are not yet in force at verification date 2026-10-27.
Corpus entries are research-verified on 2026-10-27 but not signed off by a compliance or legal SME.
